fix: Build (a), (b) and (c) in one console lane after R1 (#838).
summary: Operator request (2026-10-09): test inside the real sandbox, not a simulation. (a) One table-driven real sandbox-exec contract: each agent action with its expected allow or deny, plus every incident command as a permanent row, with a spec doc. (b) A pane-parity harness: run the tmux-dependent test packages through the real bridge boot path (pane, profile and pane env) and compare the result with the host run. A test that passes on the host and fails in the pane fails the gate. Also check the env contract (no TMUX or TMUX_PANE). (c) .github/workflows/go.yml runs make test-integration on macos-latest but installs no tmux, so the real-tmux and sandbox tests probably skip in CI. Install tmux and make that skip a CI failure.
title: Sandbox capability contract and pane-parity tests, with CI that really runs tmux
